title: T02 · Qwen 7B too big for a T4: switched to 4-bit AWQ

events.text: Detected Tesla T4 x1 (15360 MiB, compute 7.5), vLLM 0.31.0
Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct: weights 15.2 GB > GPU 15.0 GB -> skipped the download

if __name__ == "__main__":
